utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet, but I’m happy to keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. If you hear anything, just let me know and I’ll keep my list ready.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading out soon, so I’ll ask around and report back if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just a hand sorting donations and loading boxes would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with sorting and loading boxes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is definitely still happening, right? I just want to make sure before I spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d double-check the timing first so we don’t tell people too early.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll hold off until the timing’s confirmed. Can you let me know as soon as you know for sure?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive! I’m happy to help out, though I may need a reminder on what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need a few basics—batteries, duct tape, and a couple of screwdrivers if anyone has spares.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can probably scrounge up some batteries and a roll of duct tape. I’ll check my toolbox too for extra screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll check the details before doing anything. What do we know so far about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I’m not totally sure yet — I may have missed part of it. I know it’s about the repair drive, but I should check the details first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No problem — let’s verify the details first so we don’t guess. What do you remember about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, I’m a little late to the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — can you help sort tools and hand out the repair sign-up sheets?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’ll sort the tools and start handing out the sign-up sheets right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Could you bring your drill and a few screwdrivers? I’ll handle the rest and we can sort things out at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring my drill and a few screwdrivers to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep an eye on where the repair drive is set up. If you want, I can help note the exact location and timing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be great, Opal—thank you. If you can note the exact location and timing, I can plan around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll note the exact spot and the start time, then let you know right away so you can plan pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve heard the repair drive’s getting some good buzz already — folks are pitching in with tools, time, and a few spare parts. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great to hear — I’ll keep passing the word along too. If you hear they need anything specific, let me know and I’ll spread it fast.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — if I hear they need anything specific, I’ll let you know right away. Thanks for helping get the word out!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Rey — are we still on for the repair drive, and what time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Mina — yes, we’re still on. Come by at 10 and I’ll have everything ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll be there at 10. Do you want me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive to the others and keep them posted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you keeping me in the loop. Just let me know if there’s anything I should pass along too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll let everyone know about the repair drive and keep you updated. If you hear anything worth passing along, just send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted on what’s needed. If you want, I can start by making a quick list of the main fixes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help, thank you. I can send over what I know about my place.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, send it over when you can, and I’ll add it to the list. I’ll keep the updates clear so we stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is really picking up—people’ve been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you want, I can tell you what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Tess. Please tell me what they still need, and I’ll see what I can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: They’re still short on sturdy gloves, screwdrivers, and a couple of flashlights. If you can bring any of that by, they’d be thrilled.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m in late as usual, but I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — please bring a hammer, some screws, and any spare wire you’ve got. I’ll restate the plan once I know what else we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll bring a hammer, screws, and whatever spare wire I can find. I’ll check if I have anything else useful too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Rey. I’ve still got a few small things that need fixing, but I’d rather go over them quietly if that’s okay.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course, Uli. I’m here whenever you’re ready to go over them quietly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you grab a note of the exact location for each repair stop? I’m keeping the drive organized by address.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — I’ll jot down the exact address for each stop and send it over.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That repair drive sounds like a great way to bring folks together. What kind of repairs are we helping with?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d want to confirm the list first, but probably the usual household fixes—small plumbing, electrical, and anything broken that’s safe to handle. I’ll check the details before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — once you’ve got the list, I can help spread the word to the right folks.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I might’ve missed a detail there; what changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries — we’re still on for Saturday, but the time shifted to 10 a.m. at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community hall — thanks for the heads-up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know what I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. If you hear anything, just swing by and let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Gus — I’ll stop by if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you bring a screwdriver, some tape, and maybe a ladder if you have one?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring a screwdriver and tape, and I’ll check if I’ve got a ladder too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to know the schedule and where the drop-off spot is first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’ll send the schedule and the drop-off spot details next.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — just send those details when you have them, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling everyone about it today—want me to put you on the invite list too?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please put me on it — I can help keep track of supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll add you to the list right now. Thanks, Cleo, that’ll be a huge help with the supplies!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive. What time window are we working with?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m thinking late afternoon, maybe after 3:30 when school lets out. I should double-check the exact time, but that’s the window I had in mind.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work—I can plan around after 3:30. Let me know the exact time once you confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’ve got the repair drive organized and ready. If you’re able to help, I can slot you into a shift or give you a simple task.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I can help with a simple task. Just point me to what you need most.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful — could you help sort the donated tools into labeled bins? That’ll make everything easier for the volunteers.
